uncertainties: Fabrication HOLD: schematic and first placement exist, PCB not routed (handoff README, r10_gates#R10-H).
D213ECV supplier and lot unconfirmed; no distributor listing found (R10 Q1).
D213 flashless start from the central NOR is NOT_RUN; prototypes fit a D213 boot NOR (D5).
D213 GMAC0 RGMII driver, delay controls and throughput are unverified (D1, R10-E).
ECP5-12F TQFP144 pin-locked place and route is NOT_RUN until Lattice Diamond/Radiant is available (D4).
FPGA VCC power-good thresholds do not qualify the ECP5 operating minimum; rail qualification and shutdown behaviour need hardware review (r10_continuation).
ADV7513 supply filtering, layout and initialisation review open; HDMI video and audio NOT_RUN.
USB hub and role-mux enumeration NOT_RUN.
Owner confirmation that R10's four programmable devices supersede earlier three-chip rules is recorded as delegated (D2) but listed OPEN in r10_base.
The four memory pools (228 MiB total) are independent; there is no unified address space.
